name: motion-drawer
title: Motion Drawer
blurb: Side drawer slides in with spring animation, drags to close.
description: A full-height off-canvas drawer that slides from left or right with spring physics. Toggle button can merge into the drawer or stay/push. Draggable to close with threshold detection. Overlay fade on open.
use_when: You need a mobile-friendly navigation drawer that feels responsive to touch and mouse drag.
avoid_when: Your content is wider than the drawer — it will overflow without horizontal scroll.
a11y: Button has basic click/tap handling. Overlay click closes. No focus trap or ARIA labels beyond click handlers.
